title: Balanced Ternary Representation
description: Balanced ternary represents every signed integer uniquely in base `3` using the three signed digits `'-'` (`-1`), `'0'` (`0`), and `'+'` (`+1`), where digit `d_k` at position `k` from the right contributes `d_k * 3^k`. Given a 64-bit signed integer `n`, return its canonical balanced ternary string with no leading `'0'` characters (except `"0"` when `n == 0`).
hints: Extract the least significant digit using the non-negative remainder `r = ((n % 3) + 3) % 3`: `0 -> '0'`, `1 -> '+'` (subtract 1 before dividing by 3), and `2 -> '-'` (add 1 before dividing by 3).
Repeat until `n == 0` and reverse the collected digits.
